import { makeFunctionReference, type PaginationOptions, type PaginationResult } from "convex/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import type { Doc, Id } from "./_generated/dataModel";
import { components } from "./_generated/api";
import { organizationFixture } from "./platform/organizations.test-helpers";
import authSchema from "./platform/betterAuth/schema";
import { MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH } from "./platform/functions";
import { createTestEnv } from "./test.modules";

function notes<Table extends "personalNotes" | "privateNotes" | "teamNotes">(table: Table) {
  return {
    list: makeFunctionReference<"query", { paginationOpts: PaginationOptions }, PaginationResult<Doc<Table>> | null>(`${table}:list`),
    get: makeFunctionReference<"query", { id: Id<Table> }, Doc<Table> | null>(`${table}:get`),
    add: makeFunctionReference<"mutation", { body: string }, Id<Table>>(`${table}:add`),
    update: makeFunctionReference<"mutation", { id: Id<Table>; body: string }, null>(`${table}:update`),
    remove: makeFunctionReference<"mutation", { id: Id<Table> }, null>(`${table}:remove`),
  };
}
const personal = notes("personalNotes");
const privateNotes = notes("privateNotes");
const team = notes("teamNotes");
const publish = makeFunctionReference<"mutation", { id: Id<"privateNotes"> }, Id<"teamNotes">>("notePublishing:publish");
const cleanup = makeFunctionReference<"mutation", { organizationId: string }, { done: boolean }>("organizationData:deleteOrganizationData");
const firstPage = { paginationOpts: { numItems: 2, cursor: null } };

function fixture() {
  const t = createTestEnv();
  t.registerComponent("betterAuth", authSchema, import.meta.glob("./platform/betterAuth/**/*.*s"));
  return organizationFixture(t);
}

describe("documented individual accounts", () => {
  test("works without org membership and denies another user on list, get, update and delete", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    const bob = await f.user("bob");
    const id = await alice.caller.mutation(personal.add, { body: "personal" });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(personal.list, firstPage)).toMatchObject({ page: [] });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(personal.get, { id })).toBeNull();
    await expect(bob.caller.mutation(personal.update, { id, body: "stolen" })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    await expect(bob.caller.mutation(personal.remove, { id })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    await alice.caller.mutation(personal.update, { id, body: "updated" });
    expect(await alice.caller.query(personal.get, { id })).toMatchObject({ body: "updated", ownerId: alice.userId });
    expect(await f.members("missing-org")).toEqual([]);
    await alice.caller.mutation(personal.remove, { id });
    expect(await alice.caller.query(personal.get, { id })).toBeNull();
  });

  test("preserves canonical legacy ownership and ignores organization switching", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice", { userId: "legacy-alice" });
    const bob = await f.user("bob");
    const id = await alice.caller.mutation(personal.add, { body: "mine" });
    const acme = await bob.provision();
    await f.addMember(acme, alice.userId, "member");
    await alice.switchTo(acme);
    expect(await alice.caller.query(personal.get, { id })).toMatchObject({ ownerId: "legacy-alice" });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(personal.get, { id })).toBeNull();
    await alice.switchTo(null);
    expect(await alice.caller.query(personal.get, { id })).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("documented org access", () => {
  test.each(["member", "admin", "owner"])("%s can collaborate but cannot access or publish a peer's private notes", async role => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    const bob = await f.user("bob");
    const acme = await alice.provision();
    await f.addMember(acme, bob.userId, role);
    await bob.switchTo(acme);
    const own = await alice.caller.mutation(privateNotes.add, { body: "private" });
    const personalId = await alice.caller.mutation(personal.add, { body: "personal" });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(privateNotes.list, firstPage)).toMatchObject({ page: [] });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id: own })).toBeNull();
    expect(await bob.caller.query(personal.get, { id: personalId })).toBeNull();
    await expect(bob.caller.mutation(privateNotes.update, { id: own, body: "stolen" })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    await expect(bob.caller.mutation(privateNotes.remove, { id: own })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    await expect(bob.caller.mutation(publish, { id: own })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    expect(await f.t.run(ctx => ctx.db.query("teamNotes").collect())).toEqual([]);

    const shared = await alice.caller.mutation(publish, { id: own });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(team.list, firstPage)).toMatchObject({ page: [{ _id: shared }] });
    await bob.caller.mutation(team.update, { id: shared, body: "team edit" });
    expect(await alice.caller.query(team.get, { id: shared })).toMatchObject({ body: "team edit" });
    expect(await alice.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id: own })).toMatchObject({ body: "private" });
    await bob.caller.mutation(team.remove, { id: shared });
    expect(await alice.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id: own })).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("cross-org IDs and switching deny even the creator's private record outside its org", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    const bob = await f.user("bob");
    await alice.provision();
    const bobsOrg = await bob.provision();
    const id = await alice.caller.mutation(privateNotes.add, { body: "private" });
    const shared = await alice.caller.mutation(team.add, { body: "shared" });
    for (const endpoint of [privateNotes, team]) {
      const target = endpoint === privateNotes ? id : shared;
      expect(await bob.caller.query(endpoint.list, firstPage)).toMatchObject({ page: [] });
      expect(await bob.caller.query(endpoint.get, { id: target } as never)).toBeNull();
      await expect(bob.caller.mutation(endpoint.update, { id: target, body: "stolen" } as never)).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
      await expect(bob.caller.mutation(endpoint.remove, { id: target } as never)).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    }
    await f.addMember(bobsOrg, alice.userId, "member");
    await alice.switchTo(bobsOrg);
    expect(await alice.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id })).toBeNull();
    await expect(alice.caller.mutation(publish, { id })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
  });

  test("removal revokes stale-session access, fallback uses another org, rejoining restores retained private notes", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    const bob = await f.user("bob");
    const acme = await alice.provision();
    const bobsOrg = await bob.provision();
    const member = await f.addMember(acme, bob.userId, "member");
    await bob.switchTo(acme);
    const id = await bob.caller.mutation(privateNotes.add, { body: "retained" });
    const shared = await alice.caller.mutation(team.add, { body: "shared" });
    await f.t.mutation(components.betterAuth.adapter.deleteOne, { input: { model: "member", where: [{ field: "_id", value: member._id }] } });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id })).toBeNull();
    expect(await bob.caller.query(team.get, { id: shared })).toBeNull();
    await expect(bob.caller.mutation(publish, { id })).rejects.toThrow("NOTE_NOT_FOUND");
    const newNote = await bob.caller.mutation(privateNotes.add, { body: "other org" });
    expect(await bob.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id: newNote })).toMatchObject({ organizationId: bobsOrg });
    await f.addMember(acme, bob.userId, "member");
    await bob.switchTo(acme);
    expect(await bob.caller.query(privateNotes.get, { id })).toMatchObject({ body: "retained" });
  });

  test("zero memberships refuse org writes without provisioning and still allow personal writes", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    expect(await alice.caller.query(team.list, firstPage)).toBeNull();
    expect(await alice.caller.query(privateNotes.list, firstPage)).toBeNull();
    await expect(alice.caller.mutation(team.add, { body: "x" })).rejects.toThrow("NO_ORGANIZATION");
    await expect(alice.caller.mutation(privateNotes.add, { body: "x" })).rejects.toThrow("NO_ORGANIZATION");
    await alice.caller.mutation(personal.add, { body: "works" });
    expect(await f.t.query(components.betterAuth.adapter.findMany, { model: "organization", paginationOpts: { numItems: 100, cursor: null } })).toMatchObject({ page: [] });
  });
});

describe("documented collection and input boundaries", () => {
  test("every pagination page contains only the authorized user and org", async () => {
    for (const api of [personal, privateNotes, team]) {
      // A fresh deployment per model keeps the real mutation budget in force.
      const f = await fixture();
      const alice = await f.user("alice");
      const bob = await f.user("bob");
      const acme = await alice.provision();
      await f.addMember(acme, bob.userId, "member");
      await bob.switchTo(acme);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        await alice.caller.mutation(api.add, { body: `alice-${i}` });
        await bob.caller.mutation(api.add, { body: `bob-${i}` });
      }
      let cursor: string | null = null;
      const ids: string[] = [];
      for (let pageNumber = 0; pageNumber < 10; pageNumber++) {
        const page = await alice.caller.query(api.list, { paginationOpts: { numItems: 2, cursor } });
        expect(page).not.toBeNull();
        for (const note of page!.page) {
          if (api !== team) expect(note.ownerId).toBe(alice.userId);
          if ("organizationId" in note) expect(note.organizationId).toBe(acme);
          ids.push(note._id);
        }
        if (page!.isDone) break;
        cursor = page!.continueCursor;
        expect(pageNumber).toBeLessThan(9);
      }
      expect(ids).toHaveLength(api === team ? 10 : 5);
      expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);
    }
  });

  test.each(["anonymous", "limited"])("%s sessions cannot read or write any recipe", async mode => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const caller = mode === "anonymous" ? f.t : (await f.user("limited", { emailVerified: false })).caller;
    for (const api of [personal, privateNotes, team]) {
      expect(await caller.query(api.list, firstPage)).toBeNull();
      await expect(caller.mutation(api.add, { body: "x" })).rejects.toThrow();
    }
    expect(await f.t.run(ctx => ctx.db.query("personalNotes").collect())).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("validators reject forged owner/scope and excessive text without creating rows", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    await alice.provision();
    for (const api of [personal, privateNotes, team]) {
      await expect(alice.caller.mutation(api.add, { body: "forged", ownerId: "bob" } as never)).rejects.toThrow();
      await expect(alice.caller.mutation(api.add, { body: "forged", organizationId: "other" } as never)).rejects.toThrow();
      await expect(alice.caller.mutation(api.add, { body: "x".repeat(MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH + 1) })).rejects.toThrow();
      expect(await alice.caller.query(api.list, firstPage)).toMatchObject({ page: [] });
    }
  });

  test("bounded org cleanup deletes private/shared data across batches and preserves personal/other-org data", async () => {
    const f = await fixture();
    const alice = await f.user("alice");
    const bob = await f.user("bob");
    const acme = await alice.provision();
    const other = await bob.provision();
    const personalId = await alice.caller.mutation(personal.add, { body: "keep" });
    const keptPrivate = await bob.caller.mutation(privateNotes.add, { body: "keep" });
    const keptShared = await bob.caller.mutation(team.add, { body: "keep" });
    await f.t.run(async ctx => {
      for (let i = 0; i < 205; i++) await ctx.db.insert("privateNotes", { organizationId: acme, ownerId: alice.userId, body: "delete", createdAt: Date.now() });
      for (let i = 0; i < 105; i++) await ctx.db.insert("teamNotes", { organizationId: acme, ownerId: alice.userId, body: "delete", createdAt: Date.now() });
    });
    expect(await f.t.mutation(cleanup, { organizationId: acme })).toEqual({ done: false });
    expect(await f.t.run(ctx => ctx.db.query("privateNotes").withIndex("by_organization", q => q.eq("organizationId", acme)).collect())).toHaveLength(105);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await f.t.mutation(cleanup, { organizationId: acme });
    expect(await f.t.mutation(cleanup, { organizationId: acme })).toEqual({ done: true });
    expect(await f.t.run(ctx => ctx.db.query("privateNotes").collect())).toMatchObject([{ _id: keptPrivate, organizationId: other }]);
    expect(await f.t.run(ctx => ctx.db.query("teamNotes").collect())).toMatchObject([{ _id: keptShared }]);
    expect(await alice.caller.query(personal.get, { id: personalId })).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
